title: Inception Growth Acquisition Ltd 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Inception Growth Acquisition Limited (IGTA), a SPAC, withdrew its Nasdaq listing application for the combined entity following the proposed business combination with AgileAlgo Holdings Ltd. The company will continue trading on OTC Markets Group while evaluating alternative listing venues.
key_points: SPAC Inception Growth Acquisition Limited withdrew Nasdaq listing application for the combined company on April 14, 2026
The withdrawal follows consultation with Nasdaq and does not affect IGTA's existing OTC Markets listing
Company is evaluating alternative listing venues and strategic alternatives for the AgileAlgo business combination
The business combination involves a Redomestication Merger and exchange of AgileAlgo shares for PubCo ordinary shares
Existing trading symbols (IGTAU, IGTA, IGTAW, IGTAR) remain active on OTC Markets
